steps.title: Set up deck and calibrate
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map, load all required labware and tip racks, and calibrate the pipettes and labware in the Opentrons App.

substeps.instruction: Upload any custom labware definitions to the OT App.
Place the NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL) in slot 2; load magnetic beads in channel 2, wash buffer in channel 4, master mix in channel 5, and leave channel 12 empty for liquid waste.
Mount the Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2 and place a Bio‑Rad 96‑Well PCR plate (350 µL) on it.
Mount the Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN2 and place a USA Scientific PlateOne 96 Deepwell Plate (2 mL) on it.
Load Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Racks (200 µL and 1000 µL) onto the deck.
Calibrate the deck, tip racks, and pipettes (P300‑Multi GEN2 and P1000‑Single GEN2) using the OT App.

steps.title: Load samples and perform lysis
steps.instruction: Transfer each clinical sample from a 15 mL tube into the 96‑well plate on the temperature module for lysis and incubation.

substeps.instruction: Place each sample in a 15 mL tube.
Using the P1000‑Single GEN2 pipette, transfer the required volume of each sample into the corresponding well of the 96‑well PCR plate (volume not specified in the source).
Initiate the lysis reaction and temperature incubation on the temperature module (temperature and duration not specified).

steps.title: Magnetic bead RNA extraction
steps.instruction: Move lysed samples to the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module and execute a single‑wash magnetic bead‑based RNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Using the P300‑Multi GEN2 pipette, transfer the lysate from the 96‑well plate to the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module.
Add magnetic beads from reservoir channel 2 to each well.
Engage the magnetic module and allow beads to capture RNA (incubation time not specified).
Perform one wash by adding wash buffer from reservoir channel 4, then remove the wash solution.
Collect the purified RNA in the deep‑well plate; discard waste into reservoir channel 12.

steps.title: Finalize and run protocol
steps.instruction: Set protocol parameters, download the protocol package, and start the automated run.

substeps.instruction: Choose the “track tips across protocol runs” option (yes or no) as desired.
In the OT App, load the protocol and press “Run” to execute the workflow.
